suites.title: Add a product to the basket

specs.title: add one product and check the basket

steps.title: 1. The product list shows the product and an empty basket
2. Add the product to the basket
3. The basket shows one row with the product
4. The basket total is the price of the product

suites.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

specs.title: change the quantity and remove product A

steps.title: 1. The basket shows both products and the total 13.98¤
2. Plus button on product A: quantity 2, total 18.97¤
3. Minus button on product A: quantity 1, total 13.98¤
4. Minus button on product A again: quantity stays 1
5. Trash button on product A: only product B stays

specs.title: order two products with a card and find the order in the history

steps.title: 1. Add product A two times and product B one time: counter 3
2. The basket shows both products and the total 20.97¤
3. Checkout, select the saved address and continue: delivery page opens
4. Select One Day Delivery and continue: payment page opens
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue: order summary with 19.86¤
7. Place the order: the confirmation page opens
8. The confirmation shows both products and the totals
9. The basket counter is 0 and the basket is empty
10. Order history shows the order with the total 19.86¤
